options.explanation: Gold oxford under the black chore coat is warm against cool, and the yellow sock carries the gold down to the ankle instead of repeating the cream trouser.
Clay linen over slate is greyed adjacency with one warm voice; the soft olive pleats keep it off the office drone, and the shoe decides at the door.
Sprezzatura on a quiet day: a washed pink oxford under a burgundy knit tie, one red carried at three depths down to the sock, and the navy sneaker answering the blazer.
Denim shirt and walnut chino are the RRL end of the academy; the waxed Chasseur covers the eleven-degree start and the strong-blue sock rhymes with the shirt.
The home key, done properly: light blue oxford and sand cotton-linen under the field jacket, with a forest-green sock as the single flash.
